description: Parameters consumed by the AQA test stage. Vendor overrides may suppress, replace, or extend these via a vendor-scripts/14-aqa-tests.params.json in the config repo.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled. All stage-gate parameters are collected here so operators can see and adjust the full execution plan in one place.

parameters.name: RUN_TESTS
parameters.description: Enable test stages (smoke tests, AQA, TCK). Set to false to skip all testing — useful for build-only runs or when test infrastructure is unavailable.

parameterGroups.name: AQAVit Test Options
parameterGroups.description: Parameters for AQAVit testing. Leave empty to use the defaults defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.

parameters.name: AQA_REF
parameters.description: Git branch or tag for the aqa-tests repository. Empty = default branch defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.
